_rules: WRITER-BRIEF step 4: photorealistic documentary photography, real work, regionally correct architecture and light, no text/logos/brand names, faces turned away or out of frame. Hero = wide establishing shot (2K, 16:9 -> 1800 wide); work-1..3 = close on the first three services (1K, 16:9 -> 900 wide). Model gpt-image-2.5-sunburst on ElevenLabs creative, 25 Oct 2026.
_suffix: Photorealistic documentary photograph, natural light, 35mm lens, unposed. No text, no lettering, no numbers, no logos, no brand or company names anywhere, including on trucks, vans, equipment, containers, clothing and packaging. Any people are seen from behind or cropped out of frame, no faces.
